---
title: Short pasta with sardines
id: MAR-0085
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g of short pasta
- 12 sardines
- 40 g of breadcrumbs
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Crush the garlic and peel it.
2. Fillet the sardines, removing the scales.
3. Sauté the garlic for 2 minutes in a pan with 2 tablespoons of oil.
4. Remove it, add the sardines and cook them for one minute per side, then sprinkle them with the breadcrumbs.
5. Cook the short pasta in plenty of salted boiling water, drain it, pour it into a serving bowl, season it with the sardines with breadcrumbs and the remaining oil, mix gently and serve.
